practiceQuestions.q: On which date did the Constituent Assembly of India hold its first meeting?
practiceQuestions.sol: The Constituent Assembly held its first meeting on December 9, 1946.

practiceQuestions.q: How many members attended the first meeting of the Constituent Assembly on December 9, 1946?
practiceQuestions.sol: Only 211 members attended the first meeting because the Muslim League boycotted it.

practiceQuestions.q: Why did the Muslim League boycotte the first meeting of the Constituent Assembly?
opts: They objected to the Cabinet Mission Plan.
They demanded a separate sovereign state of Pakistan.
They wanted more representation in the interim government.
They wanted the Viceroy to preside over the assembly.
practiceQuestions.sol: The Muslim League boycotted the meeting and insisted on a separate state of Pakistan.

practiceQuestions.q: Who was elected as the temporary President of the Constituent Assembly during its first meeting?
practiceQuestions.sol: Dr. Sachchidananda Sinha, the oldest member of the assembly, was elected as the temporary President.

practiceQuestions.q: The election of Dr. Sachchidananda Sinha as temporary President of the Constituent Assembly followed the practice of which country?
practiceQuestions.sol: Following the French practice, Dr. Sachchidananda Sinha, being the oldest member, was elected as the temporary President of the Assembly.

practiceQuestions.q: Who was elected as the permanent President of the Constituent Assembly on December 11, 1946?
practiceQuestions.sol: Dr. Rajendra Prasad was elected as the permanent President of the Constituent Assembly on December 11, 1946.

practiceQuestions.q: Who were elected as the two Vice-Presidents of the Constituent Assembly?
opts: H.C. Mookerjee and Sir B.N. Rau
Dr. Rajendra Prasad and Jawaharlal Nehru
practiceQuestions.sol: The Assembly had two Vice-Presidents: H.C. Mookerjee and V.T. Krishnamachari.

practiceQuestions.q: Who was appointed as the Constitutional Advisor (Legal Advisor) to the Constituent Assembly?
practiceQuestions.sol: Sir B.N. Rau was appointed as the Constitutional Advisor to the assembly.

practiceQuestions.q: Who moved the historic 'Objectives Resolution' in the Constituent Assembly?
practiceQuestions.sol: Jawaharlal Nehru moved the historic 'Objectives Resolution' on December 13, 1946.

practiceQuestions.q: On which date did the Constituent Assembly adopt the historic 'Objectives Resolution'?
practiceQuestions.sol: The Objectives Resolution was unanimously adopted by the Assembly on January 22, 1947.

practiceQuestions.q: Which part of the present Indian Constitution is a modified version of the Objectives Resolution?
practiceQuestions.sol: The Preamble to the present Constitution is the modified version of the historic Objectives Resolution.

practiceQuestions.q: When did the Constituent Assembly ratify India's membership in the Commonwealth of Nations?
practiceQuestions.sol: The Assembly ratified India's membership in the Commonwealth in May 1949.

practiceQuestions.q: On which date was the National Flag of India adopted by the Constituent Assembly?
practiceQuestions.sol: The National Flag of India was adopted by the Constituent Assembly on July 22, 1947.

practiceQuestions.q: Pingali Venkayya is associated with the design of which national symbol?
practiceQuestions.sol: Pingali Venkayya designed the National Flag, which was adopted by the Assembly in July 1947.

practiceQuestions.q: On which date did the Constituent Assembly adopt the National Anthem of India?
practiceQuestions.sol: The National Anthem of India was adopted by the Constituent Assembly on January 24, 1950.

practiceQuestions.q: The National Song of India ('Vande Mataram') was adopted by the Constituent Assembly on:
practiceQuestions.sol: The National Song was adopted by the Constituent Assembly on January 24, 1950.

practiceQuestions.q: Who was elected as the first President of India by the Constituent Assembly on January 24, 1950?
practiceQuestions.sol: Dr. Rajendra Prasad was elected as the first President of India by the Constituent Assembly on January 24, 1950.

practiceQuestions.q: How many sessions did the Constituent Assembly hold during its constitution-making period?
practiceQuestions.sol: The Constituent Assembly held 11 sessions over the course of constitution-making.

practiceQuestions.q: How much time did the Constituent Assembly take to complete the drafting of the Constitution?
practiceQuestions.sol: The Assembly took exactly 2 years, 11 months, and 18 days to draft the Constitution.

practiceQuestions.q: What was the total expenditure incurred in making the Constitution of India?
practiceQuestions.sol: The total expenditure incurred was approximately Rs. 64 lakh.

practiceQuestions.q: The Constituent Assembly analyzed the constitutions of how many countries while drafting the Indian Constitution?
practiceQuestions.sol: The makers of the Constitution went through the constitutions of about 60 countries.

practiceQuestions.q: For how many days was the draft constitution considered by the Constituent Assembly?
practiceQuestions.sol: The draft constitution was considered for 114 days.

practiceQuestions.q: Who served as the Secretary to the Constituent Assembly?
practiceQuestions.sol: H.V.R. Iengar was the Secretary to the Constituent Assembly.

practiceQuestions.q: Who was the Chief Draftsman of the Constitution in the Constituent Assembly?
practiceQuestions.sol: S.N. Mukerjee was the Chief Draftsman of the Constitution in the Constituent Assembly.

practiceQuestions.q: Who was the calligrapher of the original English version of the Indian Constitution?
practiceQuestions.sol: Prem Behari Narain Raizada calligraphed the original English version in a flowing italic style.

practiceQuestions.q: Who calligraphed the Hindi version of the original Constitution?
practiceQuestions.sol: Vasant Krishan Vaidya calligraphed the Hindi version of the original Constitution.

practiceQuestions.q: Which institution's artists decorated and illuminated the pages of the original Indian Constitution?
practiceQuestions.sol: Artists from Shantiniketan (including Nandlal Bose and Beohar Rammanohar Sinha) decorated the original manuscript pages.

practiceQuestions.q: Which artist calligraphed and illuminated the Preamble page of the original Constitution?
practiceQuestions.sol: Beohar Rammanohar Sinha calligraphed and illuminated the Preamble page of the original Constitution.

practiceQuestions.q: Who was the Chairman of the Union Powers Committee of the Constituent Assembly?
practiceQuestions.sol: Jawaharlal Nehru was the Chairman of the Union Powers Committee.

practiceQuestions.q: Who headed the Union Constitution Committee of the Constituent Assembly?
practiceQuestions.sol: Jawaharlal Nehru was the Chairman of the Union Constitution Committee.

practiceQuestions.q: Who was the Chairman of the Provincial Constitution Committee?
practiceQuestions.sol: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel was the Chairman of the Provincial Constitution Committee.

practiceQuestions.q: The Advisory Committee on Fundamental Rights, Minorities and Tribal and Excluded Areas was headed by:
practiceQuestions.sol: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel headed this large advisory committee.

practiceQuestions.q: Who was the Chairman of the Drafting Committee of the Constituent Assembly?
practiceQuestions.sol: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar was the Chairman of the Drafting Committee, setup on August 29, 1947.

practiceQuestions.q: Who chaired the Rules of Procedure Committee of the Constituent Assembly?
practiceQuestions.sol: Dr. Rajendra Prasad headed the Rules of Procedure Committee.

practiceQuestions.q: Who was the Chairman of the Steering Committee of the Constituent Assembly?
practiceQuestions.sol: Dr. Rajendra Prasad was the Chairman of the Steering Committee.

practiceQuestions.q: Who headed the States Committee (Committee for Negotiating with States)?
practiceQuestions.sol: Jawaharlal Nehru chaired the States Committee.

practiceQuestions.q: Who was the Chairman of the House Committee of the Constituent Assembly?
practiceQuestions.sol: B. Pattabhi Sitaramayya was the Chairman of the House Committee.

practiceQuestions.q: Who headed the Fundamental Rights Sub-Committee of the Advisory Committee?
practiceQuestions.sol: J.B. Kripalani was the Chairman of the Fundamental Rights Sub-Committee.

practiceQuestions.q: Who headed the Minorities Sub-Committee of the Advisory Committee?
practiceQuestions.sol: H.C. Mookerjee was the Chairman of the Minorities Sub-Committee.

practiceQuestions.q: Which animal was adopted as the symbol (seal) of the Constituent Assembly?
practiceQuestions.sol: The Elephant was adopted as the symbol (seal) of the Constituent Assembly.

practiceQuestions.q: How many members actually signed the Constitution when it was adopted on November 26, 1949?
practiceQuestions.sol: Out of 299 total members, exactly 284 members were present on November 26, 1949, and signed the Constitution.

practiceQuestions.q: What was the legislative status of the Constituent Assembly from January 26, 1950, until the first general elections?
opts: It acted as the Provisional Parliament of India.
It acted as the Council of States.
It became the Supreme Court of India.
practiceQuestions.sol: From January 26, 1950, the Constituent Assembly acted as the Provisional Parliament of India until the new elected Parliament was formed in May 1952.

practiceQuestions.q: Who headed the North-East Frontier Tribal Areas and Assam Excluded & Partially Excluded Areas Sub-Committee?
practiceQuestions.sol: Gopinath Bardoloi headed this sub-committee.

practiceQuestions.q: Who headed the Excluded and Partially Excluded Areas (Other than those in Assam) Sub-Committee?
practiceQuestions.sol: A.V. Thakkar was the Chairman of this sub-committee.

practiceQuestions.q: How many readings did the draft constitution undergo in the Constituent Assembly?
practiceQuestions.sol: The draft constitution underwent three detailed readings in the Assembly before final passage on November 26, 1949.

practiceQuestions.q: On which date did the final session of the Constituent Assembly take place?
practiceQuestions.sol: The Constituent Assembly held its final session on January 24, 1950, signing the original copies of the Constitution.

practiceQuestions.q: Which minor committee dealt with the functions of the Constituent Assembly?
opts: Committee on Functions of the Constituent Assembly under G.V. Mavalankar
Ad-hoc Committee on the National Flag
practiceQuestions.sol: The Committee on the Functions of the Constituent Assembly was chaired by G.V. Mavalankar.

practiceQuestions.q: Who was the Chairman of the Ad-hoc Committee on the National Flag?
practiceQuestions.sol: Dr. Rajendra Prasad was the Chairman of the Ad-hoc Committee on the National Flag.

practiceQuestions.q: The original constitution was published by the Survey of India in which city?
practiceQuestions.sol: The calligraphed pages were photolithographed and published by the Survey of India at Dehradun.

practiceQuestions.q: When did the newly elected Parliament of India (both houses) come into existence?
practiceQuestions.sol: The first elected bicameral Parliament of India came into existence in May 1952, replacing the Provisional Parliament.

mockTestQuestions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the Constituent Assembly's first meeting:
1. It took place on December 9, 1946, and was attended by 389 members.
2. Dr. Sachchidananda Sinha was elected temporary President following the French practice of choosing the oldest member.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
mockTestQuestions.sol: Statement 1 is incorrect because only 211 members attended the first meeting, as the Muslim League boycotted it. Statement 2 is correct because Dr. Sachchidananda Sinha was elected temporary President following the French practice of selecting the oldest member.

mockTestQuestions.q:
With reference to the office bearers of the Constituent Assembly, which of the following statements is/are correct?
1. Dr. Rajendra Prasad was elected as President and H.C. Mookerjee was the sole Vice-President.
2. Sir B.N. Rau was appointed as the Constitutional Advisor to the Assembly.
Select the correct answer using the code given below:
mockTestQuestions.sol: Statement 1 is incorrect because the assembly had two Vice-Presidents: H.C. Mookerjee and V.T. Krishnamachari. Statement 2 is correct: Sir B.N. Rau was the Constitutional/Legal Advisor.

mockTestQuestions.q:
Consider the following statements about the 'Objectives Resolution':
1. It was introduced in the Assembly by Jawaharlal Nehru on December 13, 1946.
2. It was unanimously adopted by the Assembly on January 22, 1947.
3. Its modified version forms the Preamble of the present Constitution.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
mockTestQuestions.sol: All three statements are correct. The Objectives Resolution was moved by Nehru on Dec 13, 1946, adopted on Jan 22, 1947, and became the Preamble in its modified form.

mockTestQuestions.q:
Which of the following functions were performed by the Constituent Assembly in addition to drafting the Constitution?
1. Ratification of India's membership in the Commonwealth in May 1949.
2. Adoption of the National Flag on July 22, 1947.
3. Adoption of the National Anthem and National Song on January 24, 1950.
4. Election of Dr. Rajendra Prasad as the first President of India on January 24, 1950.
Select the correct answer using the code given below:
mockTestQuestions.sol: All four functions were performed by the Constituent Assembly on the respective dates specified.

mockTestQuestions.q:
Match the following Major Committees of the Constituent Assembly with their Chairmen:
List I (Committee) - List II (Chairman)
I. Union Powers Committee - A. Sardar Patel
II. Provincial Constitution Committee - B. Dr. B.R. Ambedkar
III. Drafting Committee - C. Jawaharlal Nehru
IV. Steering Committee - D. Dr. Rajendra Prasad
Select the correct matches:
mockTestQuestions.sol: Union Powers Committee: Nehru; Provincial Constitution: Patel; Drafting Committee: Ambedkar; Steering Committee: Prasad.

mockTestQuestions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the calligraphy and decoration of the original Indian Constitution:
1. Prem Behari Narain Raizada was the calligrapher of the original English version.
2. Vasant Krishan Vaidya calligraphed the Hindi version.
3. The illumination and decoration were done by artists from Shantiniketan under Nandlal Bose.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
mockTestQuestions.sol: All three statements are correct. Prem Behari Narain Raizada wrote the English version, Vasant Krishan Vaidya calligraphed the Hindi version, and artists from Shantiniketan (led by Nandlal Bose) decorated the pages.

mockTestQuestions.q: Who was the Chairman of the Committee on the Functions of the Constituent Assembly when it met in its legislative capacity?
mockTestQuestions.sol: G.V. Mavalankar was the Chairman of the Committee on the Functions of the Constituent Assembly and presided over its legislative sessions as Speaker.

mockTestQuestions.q:
With reference to the timeline and stats of the Constituent Assembly, which of the following statements is/are correct?
1. The Assembly held 11 sessions over a period of 2 years, 11 months, and 18 days.
2. The total expenditure incurred in framing the Constitution was Rs. 64 lakh.
Select the correct answer using the code given below:
mockTestQuestions.sol: Both statements are correct. The Assembly took 2 years, 11 months, and 18 days (11 sessions) and spent Rs. 64 lakh.

mockTestQuestions.q: Which of the following sub-committees under the Advisory Committee was chaired by H.C. Mookerjee?
mockTestQuestions.sol: H.C. Mookerjee was the Chairman of the Minorities Sub-Committee of the Advisory Committee. J.B. Kripalani chaired the FR Sub-Committee.

mockTestQuestions.q: On January 26, 1950, the Constituent Assembly became the Provisional Parliament of India. Until when did it continue in this capacity?
opts: Until the first general elections in 1951-52 and formation of the new elected Parliament in May 1952
Until the first Republic Day on January 26, 1951
Until the reorganised States took shape in 1956
It is still functioning as part of Lok Sabha.
mockTestQuestions.sol: The Provisional Parliament ceased to exist in May 1952 when the first elected bicameral Parliament of India met after the first general elections of 1951-52.
